'''Ord Pardron''' was a tiny [[Planet/Legends|planet]] with a thin [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] in the [[Ord Pardron system/Legends|Ord Pardron system]] of the [[Dufilvian sector/Legends|Dufilvian sector]], located in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].

==Description==
The [[Planet/Legends|planet]] was a rocky world with low [[Gravity/Legends|gravity]] and a thin atmosphere, it was classified as an asteroid.<ref name="TLCS" />

It was rich in [[Mineral/Legends|minerals]] and [[Ore/Legends|ores]].<ref name="TLCS" />

==History==
{{Quote|Two days ago the Imperials launched a multiple attack on targets in the Abrion and Dufilvian sectors. They severely damaged the military base at Ord Pardron and captured the Ukio system.|[[Talon Karrde]] to [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]]|<ref name="TLC">''[[The Last Command]]''</ref>}}
The planet was originally a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Ordnance/Regional Depot/Legends|Ordnance/Regional Depot]], lending the planet its name. It was heavily mined by the Republic and then the Empire.<ref name="TLCS" />

It was the site of a major [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] military base, with approximately 68,000 troops, defending the [[Abrion sector/Legends|Abrion]] and [[Dufilvian sector/Legends|Dufilvian]] [[Sector/Legends|sectors]]. [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn's]] forces hit many targets in the area at once, reducing Ord Pardron's own defenses to the bare minimum as it sent help to the devastated worlds. The base was, as a result, unable to assist Thrawn's true target, the planet [[Ukio/Legends|Ukio]]. Ukio was [[Battle at Ukio|captured]], and the Ord Pardron base was [[Battle of Ord Pardron|severely damaged]].<ref name="TLC" />

Ord Pardron was also the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Dera Jynsol]], one of [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian's]] candidates for marriage.<ref name="AaC">''[[Ambush at Corellia]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Planet06-SWR.png|thumb|right|200px|Ord Pardon in ''Star Wars: Rebellion''.]]
The PC game [[Star Wars: Rebellion (video game)|''Star Wars: Rebellion'']] refers to the planet as "Ord Pardon." The game also mistakenly places the [[Dufilvian sector/Legends|Dufilvan sector]] (a misspelling of the true [[Dufilvian sector/Legends|Dufilvian sector]]) and, consequently, Ord Pardron, in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. The planet was represented as a temperate world in ''Star Wars: Rebellion'' whereas the ''[[The Last Command Sourcebook]]'' clearly identified as an planetoid asteroid.
